chunks.title: How to start a directional run
chunks.text:
To start a directional run, open the Run Configuration dialog, choose Live Run, fill in Well and Wellbore, and add one or more Target Points.

When target points are present, they are sent to the trajectory system and used for guided drilling toward the selected path.

Use this mode when the run should follow planned targets instead of staying fully manual.

chunks.title: How to start a manual run
chunks.text:
To start a manual run, open the Run Configuration dialog, choose Live Run, fill in Well and Wellbore, and leave Target Points empty.

Starting with no target points means the run is treated as manual drilling.

During operation, pressing the red circular Disable Drives button stops autonomous drilling and returns control to manual mode.

chunks.title: How to receive vibration feedback
chunks.text:
To receive vibration feedback, hold the black button on the left joystick.

To change vibration source, use the left joystick hat left and right control.

The operator-facing vibration sources are:
Torsional + Lateral
Torsional only
Lateral only
Axial only

Internally, the currently selected source is associated with the raw alias `JoystickFeedbackMode`.
